name: Sukhoi Su-26 / Su-29 / Su-31
summary: Soviet unlimited aerobatic monoplane family that dominated world championships; the Su-29 is the two-seat version.

wings: Straight mid-set monoplane wing with long ailerons and no flaps
engines: Nine-cylinder Vedeneyev M-14P radial under a round cowl
fuselage: Single seat (Su-26, Su-31) or tandem two seats (Su-29) under a bubble canopy
Fixed gear with a curved titanium spring main leg and a tailwheel
tail: Large fin and rudder on a tapering fuselage

tellTales: Mid-wing radial-engined aerobatic monoplane with a short bubble canopy
Fixed gear with curved spring-steel main legs
Large round radial cowl on a thin symmetrical wing

confusedWith.howToTell: The Yak-55 has a longer teardrop canopy and no root fillets; the Su-26 canopy is shorter and the wing has root fillets.
The Yak-50 has retractable main gear and a low wing; the Su-26 has fixed spring gear and a mid-set wing.
The Extra has a six-cylinder flat engine in a tight cowl; the Su-26 has a round radial cowl.
